attributes.name: NOAA GEFS forecast 16 day 0.5 degree, virtual
attributes.description: Weather forecasts from the Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS) operated by NOAA NWS NCEP, served as references to the source GRIB messages. Covers every variable the 0.5 degree pgrb2a and pgrb2b files carry, for all 31 ensemble members, through the 384 hour lead time where those files end.
attributes.attribution: NOAA NWS NCEP GEFS data processed by dynamical.org from NOAA Open Data Dissemination archives.
